title: My Beloved
paragraphs: Rifana shook her head at the apologizing Raph species’ big sister.
“Don’t worry about it. If I were in the same position as Raphtalia-chan, I would have been just as conflicted… What do all the heroes want to do?”
Upon her words, Ren, Itsuki, and Naofumi each gave their answers.
“That’s right. As Rifana-san said, this world is indeed too perfect. Sooner or later, the price will have to be paid. I will leave the decision to Motoyasu-san.”

“They say that because the future is unknown, we have to move forward, but a peace that’s handed to us by someone else’s guidance isn’t true peace. More importantly, I don’t want to leave the enemy to Naofumi and Raphtalia alone.”
“We have to make a choice… I can’t say which is right. I was saved to begin with. I’m just like Rifana-chan.”

Father and the others all looked at me. The key to rewriting the world is in my hands… That’s what this means. A branching world… The weight of that decision is immense, but something far more important stands before me.

“Right, Raphtalia-chan? Please, don’t hesitate… Don’t make a decision for my sake. I want you to prioritize defeating the enemy that caused this tragedy. Choose the path where you can definitely defeat them.”
Rifana gently pressed her forehead against the Raph species’ big sister’s.
“Rifana-chan…”
The other Raphtalia murmured softly, her face on the verge of tears.
“In Raphtalia-chan’s world, I’m already dead, aren’t I? No… there’s no way I could have survived that situation.”
“…Yes.”
“You know, back then, I wanted to return to the village I couldn’t go back to, but I wasn’t afraid of dying. Because Raphtalia-chan was by my side, always encouraging me…”
Tears welled up in the eyes of the Raph species’ big sister. The same was true for this world’s Raphtalia.

“What scared me more than dying was the thought of Raphtalia-chan dying… Even if I had died, I just wanted Raphtalia-chan to survive… I probably couldn’t say it out loud, but I thought it. That’s why… I’m happy that Raphtalia-chan is alive, even in a future where I’m gone.”
Rifana said, speaking as though she was gently guiding her.
“There’s the Spear Hero’s decision to consider, but I want you to defeat the one who caused the waves. I can never forgive them.”
Rifana repeated herself. Indeed, there was no way to forgive those who caused the waves. As I was thinking that, this world’s Raphtalia spoke up.
“The other me… right? Please… grant Rifana-chan’s wish.”
“…Understood. Rifana-chan, no matter what happens, I will defeat the enemy.”
The Raph species’ big sister gave a firm nod and turned to face me. So, I spoke.
“Big sister! How can I meet Filo-tan?”

That’s right. To me, Filo-tan matters more than the fate of the world. As long as Filo-tan is with me, everything else will work out. Ren, Itsuki, and even Father, along with big sister, almost stumbled in shock.
“…How about apologizing to Rifana-chan first for making such a difficult decision and watching over it so bravely, Motoyasu-kun?”
Father turned toward me with a chilling aura. It was similar to the time he lectured Kou in the previous world.
Ahhh… no, that’s not it! You’ve got it wrong! I was just asking something important as the Love Hunter!
“Honestly… Motoyasu-san, you never waver, even at a time like this.”
“He’s so obsessed with meeting this Filo that he’d probably commit mass murder with a smile! Why does someone like him have control over the switch to rewrite the world?”
“It’s like giving a nuclear warhead to a complete idiot!”
What do they mean by that?
“Ahaha…”
Big sister’s friend gave a strained laugh.
“Filo, huh? Speaking of which…”
The Raph species’ big sister reached out toward my spear and began chanting something.
“Ugh… this is… I didn’t notice.”
“Is something wrong?”
“Yes, it seems that taking the Spear Hero back with us won’t be easy.”
“Eh!? What do you mean?”
Father raised his voice in surprise and asked the Raph species’ big sister.

“This world was set in motion by the original wish that anchored the Dragon Hourglass of the Spear. This world was born from the Spear Hero’s obsession… but unless the Spear Hero’s dying wish—‘to see Filo’s smile’—or rather, ‘to meet Filo’—is granted, we cannot proceed.”

Oh… so that’s the condition I need to fulfill in order to escape from this world and return to the original world. Indeed, I haven’t met Filo-tan in this world yet. If I can meet her, I definitely want to.
“Then, big sister, since you’ve attained god-like omnipotence, wouldn’t finding Filo-tan be an easy task for you?”
“Is that even possible? Won’t the enemy notice?”
“If it’s just locating her, I think it’s doable. If fulfilling the Spear Hero’s wish is the condition to take him out of this world… then there’s no other choice.”
Saying that, the Raph species’ big sister began chanting again. A magic orb appeared before her.
“Using Filo’s soul waveform and magic as reference to analyze this world…”
Muttering softly, the Raph species’ big sister raised her hand toward the orb. A beam of light shot out in a straight line.
Is Filo-tan waiting for me at the end of that light?
I’m coming! But just as I was about to dash off, I saw Sakura-chan standing there, staring blankly in this direction. Before I knew it, Yuki-chan, Kou, Kuro-chan, and the Philorials had all gathered.
“Hmm?”
Sakura-chan stepped aside to avoid being in the way, but the light followed her.
What is the meaning of this?
“She is Filo, Spear Hero.”
“I knew it.”
“When you fill in the gaps about her traits, that’s the only conclusion.”
“Considering the circumstantial evidence, it makes sense.”
“I couldn’t say anything because Motoyasu-kun insisted otherwise.”
Father and the others nodded as if they were convinced.
W-What are they talking about!?
“That’s wrong! Sakura-chan is Sakura-chan, not Filo-tan!”
That’s right! Sakura-chan is a proper Philorial, completely different from Filo-tan.

Honestly… everyone, including Fiancée, is misunderstanding. Filo-tan is the adorable, blonde-haired, blue-eyed treasure of this world. Her Philorial form is white with cherry blossom accents. Sakura-chan, on the other hand, has pinkish-blue eyes and changes her appearance depending on the situation—sometimes an adult, sometimes a child. Her Philorial form is completely pink.
How could they be the same?
Sure, they smell similar, but they’re totally different!
“But it’s the truth. Maybe her appearance changed due to the circumstances of her growth?”
“I think so too. I can’t think of any other explanation.”
“Right?”
“No, no, no! That’s absolutely not true!”
I’m throwing a fit.
What’s this? Are they saying Fiancée, who gets along with everyone like a best friend upon meeting them, is correct?
No way! Fiancée is cheating on Filo-tan with Sakura-chan!
“You’re such a troublesome person. I’m starting to understand how Naofumi-sama feels.”
The Raph species’ big sister said with an exasperated sigh. No matter what happens, this is wrong.
Big sister’s magic is mistaken!
“I knew Motoyasu-kun felt neglected in the original world, but this reaction is…”
“There’s no defending this.”
“Also, calling me ‘Spear Hero’ like that feels so distant.”
Father and the others are unfairly lowering their opinion of me.
That’s not true! I am the Love Hunter! Sakura-chan is Sakura-chan!
“I knew it. There must be some reason why Sakura has become the object of the Spear Hero’s affection.”
“Now that you mention it, that deranged Gaelion did pounce on Sakura-chan, didn’t he?”
“Ugh… that was an unpleasant memory. But at that time, Gaelion saw Sakura as a blonde, blue-eyed little girl. That was probably Filo.”
My rival covered her mouth and muttered bitterly.
No! That’s wrong! Filo-tan is Filo-tan!
